All 39 sites are lockfile declarations of secp256k1 implementations (secp256k1@3/4, tiny-secp256k1, @noble/secp256k1) pulled in by the Ethereum toolchain. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak256 is the hash backbone of the shipped contracts: EIP-712 DOMAIN_SEPARATOR and PERMIT_TYPEHASH, CREATE2 pair salts and init-code hashes (SwapsFactory/UniswapV2Factory), function selectors, plus web3.utils.keccak256 in the test permit-digest helper. Sites mix lockfile dependency entries (keccak, @ethersproject/keccak256), Solidity call sites, JS call sites, and uniswap/build compiler artifacts — all genuine. SHA-3/Keccak is PQ-acceptable (A-).

properties.name: pqs:context

Dependency-inventory asset; no direct PBKDF2 call site in application code
